sloka: ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः।अर्थ्यं विज्ञापयंश्चापि हनुमन्तमिदं वचः ।। ६.७५.१ ।।
transliteration: tato 'bravīnmahātejāḥ sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ।arthyaṁ vijñāpayaṁścāpi hanumantamidaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.75.1 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the king of Vanaras called Hanuman to make him know the task ahead and said these words.
